# Bonooru conformance vectors (AD-14). Format: vectors/README.md.
# Generated by an independent implementation and reviewed by hand;
# a wire change edits these files first.
#
# state.txt: the canonical 8-byte state (AD-10): bytes + fields.
# fields: buttons as a big-endian u16, the rest as bytes.
proto_version: 01

# NEUTRAL: no button, hat neutral, sticks centred, no flag
neutral.bytes: 00 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
neutral.fields: buttons=0000 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button Y alone: bit 0 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_y.bytes: 01 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_y.fields: buttons=0001 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button B alone: bit 1 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_b.bytes: 02 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_b.fields: buttons=0002 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button A alone: bit 2 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_a.bytes: 04 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_a.fields: buttons=0004 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button X alone: bit 3 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_x.bytes: 08 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_x.fields: buttons=0008 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button L alone: bit 4 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_l.bytes: 10 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_l.fields: buttons=0010 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button R alone: bit 5 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_r.bytes: 20 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_r.fields: buttons=0020 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button ZL alone: bit 6 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_zl.bytes: 40 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_zl.fields: buttons=0040 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button ZR alone: bit 7 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_zr.bytes: 80 00 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_zr.fields: buttons=0080 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button MINUS alone: bit 8 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_minus.bytes: 00 01 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_minus.fields: buttons=0100 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button PLUS alone: bit 9 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_plus.bytes: 00 02 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_plus.fields: buttons=0200 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button L3 alone: bit 10 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_l3.bytes: 00 04 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_l3.fields: buttons=0400 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button R3 alone: bit 11 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_r3.bytes: 00 08 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_r3.fields: buttons=0800 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button HOME alone: bit 12 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_home.bytes: 00 10 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_home.fields: buttons=1000 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# button CAPTURE alone: bit 13 (buttons little-endian on the wire)
btn_capture.bytes: 00 20 08 80 80 80 80 00
btn_capture.fields: buttons=2000 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# NEUTRAL|END: the last event of a piece
end_on_neutral.bytes: 00 00 08 80 80 80 80 01
end_on_neutral.fields: buttons=0000 hat=08 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=01

# a diagonal hat: 5 = down-left
hat_down_left.bytes: 00 00 05 80 80 80 80 00
hat_down_left.fields: buttons=0000 hat=05 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00

# both sticks at 00 (ly 00 = up)
sticks_min.bytes: 00 00 08 00 00 00 00 00
sticks_min.fields: buttons=0000 hat=08 lx=00 ly=00 rx=00 ry=00 flags=00

# both sticks at ff (ly ff = down)
sticks_max.bytes: 00 00 08 ff ff ff ff 00
sticks_max.fields: buttons=0000 hat=08 lx=ff ly=ff rx=ff ry=ff flags=00

# all 14 buttons, hat up
all_buttons.bytes: ff 3f 00 80 80 80 80 00
all_buttons.fields: buttons=3fff hat=00 lx=80 ly=80 rx=80 ry=80 flags=00
